examples.arabic: ابي اشترى لي معطف حلو ليحميني من الجو العاصف والضباب برا
examples.english: My father bought me a nice coat to protect me from the windy weather and the fog outside.
examples.transliteration: abi shtara li maataf helo liyahmini men el jaw el aasef w el dabab barra

examples.arabic: بس اليوم السما غايمة وفي ضباب بكل مكان
examples.english: But today the sky is cloudy and there is fog everywhere.
examples.transliteration: Bas el yom el sama ghaima w fi dabab bi kel makan

examples.arabic: كان يوم خريف والجو فيه ضباب خفيف
examples.english: It was an autumn day and the weather had light fog.
examples.transliteration: Kaan yom khareef wal jaww fee dabab khafeef.

examples.arabic: الجو قلب عاصفة والرياح صارت قوية والضباب بلش ينتشر
examples.english: The weather turned into a storm and the winds became strong and fog started to spread.
examples.transliteration: Al-jaww qalab aasifa wal-riyah sarat qawiya wal-dabab ballash yantashir.
